purpose: Test whether the region-tagged workflow transfers to an external image classifier (VNN-COMP mnist_fc, mnist-net_256x2) that we did not train.
external_network: external/vnncomp/mnist_fc/onnx/mnist-net_256x2.onnx (784-256-256-10 ReLU, VNN-COMP mnist_fc; input shape [1,784,1], inputs in [0,1])

data.source: official MNIST (~/.keras/datasets/mnist.npz), numpy load, no TensorFlow
data.anchors: correctly-classified test images, 2 per class by ascending test index (held out); region calibration uses train split only

regions_planned: R2 R1 + class total-mass band (mu_c +- 2 sigma_c, train)
R4 local PCA same-class train neighbors
R5 same-class nearest-neighbor per-pixel box (K=100 train)

regions_blocked.R3_R4: decoder/PCA composition requires maraboupy (import hangs on this filesystem) or onnx graph surgery (onnx lib absent); cannot compose onto the external ONNX
regions_blocked.R6: TV bound needs auxiliary slack variables, not expressible in the pure VNN-LIB subset the Marabou CLI parses; maraboupy path unavailable

properties.P4_ext_targeted: single-target class-confusion Y_t >= Y_c with t = runner-up class on the clean anchor (deterministic)
properties.P3_ext_robustness: full OR_{j!=c} Y_j >= Y_c; attempted but the OR property is markedly slower than single-target on this net

solver: Marabou 2.0 CLI on the external ONNX, split-and-conquer, 4 workers, 120 s per query, exact status parsing (no substring matching)
audit_signals: nearest-real L2 to held-out test (same-class and all-class)
nearest-real L2 to train (same-class and all-class)
note: Specs/epsilons of any VNN-COMP file are NOT modified. This region-transfer run is separate from the mnist_fc expected-label plumbing calibration.
